scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w webapp"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w webapp
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w shared && npm --prefix mobileapp start
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w webapp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w webapp
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w webapp
